# Connect Convex deployment (`connect_convex_deployment`)

MCP tool `vault_convex_connectExistingProject` · scope `access_app_create` · write

The manual Convex attach: binds an existing Convex project (from `list_convex_projects`) to the
app's record and starts the connection run. This is also the remedy `get_user_vaults` names as
`nextAction: "connect_convex_deployment"` after a failed manual Convex attach. Rerunning it with a
valid target is the repair.

Writes Samebase's deployment record and reads the project from Convex; it does not modify the
project itself. Progress and failure are readable through `get_user_vaults` (`providerSetup` with
step, message, and `nextAction`).

## Arguments

- `vaultId` (string, required): Samebase vault id of the app to attach the Convex project to.
- `appId` (string, required): Stable Samebase app id that will own the Convex deployment.
- `projectId` (string, required): Convex project id from list_convex_projects.

## Returns

The reply is confirmation text only; the tool sets no `structuredContent`.
